name: glx-monorepo
description: Root package.json for GLX Industries Unified ERP & Showcase System

scripts.install-all: npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend && npm run install-showcase
scripts.sync-erp: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('showcase-web/public/erp')) fs.rmSync('showcase-web/public/erp', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'showcase-web/public/erp', {recursive:true}); console.log('ERP synced to showcase-web/public/erp');"
scripts.build: npm run build-frontend && npm run sync-erp && npm run build-showcase
